record.source_closeout_reference: Rung-2 rerun-path recording mission RUNG2_RERUN_PREP_20260611; envelope and decision record under docs/Factory/v3/ladder/rung2/; committed with the mission changes per the same_commit convention

mission.objective: Record sponsor decision HDI-RUNG2-003 (rung-2 rerun path = Option A: genuinely larger scope under the unchanged wall-clock band, stop threshold raised to 1100) and update the ladder status and anchor registry.

forbidden_scope: no rerun execution or design-review execution
no validator, fixture, template, or skill changes
no POC-repo changes within this mission
no new approval or promotion language
no files outside the envelope list
allowed_commands: scoped git add, commit, and push at closeout

verification.summary: Advisory suite run at closeout after all authorized-file edits; results recorded below.

notes: Docs-only recording mission; the decision record keeps the wall-clock pass criterion unchanged and raises only the budget class, resolving the attempt-1 stop-threshold contradiction without touching the pack criteria.
The record names the mandatory Option B routing on a second duration failure, so the rerun cannot silently become a third attempt under unchanged assumptions.
Pre-rerun fixes are named as rerun-envelope obligations (vendored canon, harness speed/effort recording), not as separate unbounded work.
No halt or fallback trigger fired; all edits stayed inside the five authorized files.

friction_notes: Third recording mission of the day with near-identical envelope boilerplate; a lightweight recording-mission template (envelope + decision record + record skeleton) would cut the per-decision recording cost meaningfully and is a natural candidate once the friction-note rollup mission runs.
false_positive_notes: None observed in this mission's advisory pass.
false_negative_notes: No false negatives observed after the advisory pass.

phase2_design_signals: The failure-handling rule gives Option A a built-in escape: choosing the more conservative rerun path is cheap to honor because a second duration failure routes to the design review automatically — sponsors can prefer goalpost stability knowing the criteria question cannot be dodged twice.
Sizing the rerun from measured throughput (calls per minute) rather than estimated minutes is the first time a ladder envelope's budget class is derived from same-lane measured data end to end.
